notes.title: Pre-Order Store Now Open
notes.content:
[h1]Kickstarter Funded[/h1]
Our Kickstarter for Externus: Path of the Solari hit our goal of $50,000 and made the game available at the pre-order price of $20 (Regular Price: $24.99) to those who backed us on Kickstarter. We will be able to complete the game in the window of time we expect, so thank you to all backers. 

[h1]Pre-Order Now![/h1]
We have also opened up our own pre-order store, where you can still get the exclusive pre-order prices of $20 for Externus and choose which platform you want the game on, including Steam. You can check out the store here. [url=https://externus.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders]Pre-Order Store[/url]

[h1]Pre-Alpha Demo Available[/h1]
Don't forget we also have our pre-alpha demo (which also serves as a lead in to the game) available now on our website. Download it [url=http://www.externusgame.com]HERE[/url] 

We appreciate all the support we have received from everyone. Please feel free to continue following us and help us build our community.
